medicalCondition.name: Diabetes
medicalCondition.description: Condition characterized by impaired insulin function, requiring careful management of carbohydrate intake and blood glucose levels.

medicalCondition.name: Celiac Disease
medicalCondition.description: Autoimmune disorder requiring strict avoidance of gluten-containing foods, common in wheat, barley, and rye.

medicalCondition.name: Lactose Intolerance
medicalCondition.description: Inability to digest lactose, necessitating avoidance or limitation of dairy products containing lactose.

medicalCondition.name: Food Allergies
medicalCondition.description: Immune response to specific allergens, requiring elimination and careful reading of food labels.

medicalCondition.name: Hypertension
medicalCondition.description: Condition characterized by high blood pressure, requiring reduced sodium intake and a focus on whole, unprocessed foods.

medicalCondition.name: Kidney Disease
medicalCondition.description: Impaired kidney function necessitating limitation of potassium, phosphorus, and protein intake based on disease stage.

medicalCondition.name: Gastrointestinal Disorders
medicalCondition.description: Conditions like IBS and IBD requiring identification and avoidance of trigger foods, and adjustment of fiber intake.

medicalCondition.name: Heart Disease
medicalCondition.description: Cardiovascular condition requiring reduced saturated and trans fats, and emphasis on heart-healthy fats.

medicalCondition.name: Gout
medicalCondition.description: Inflammatory arthritis condition requiring limitation of purine-rich foods and careful management of alcohol intake.

medicalCondition.name: Epilepsy
medicalCondition.description: Neurological disorder managed with a ketogenic diet under medical supervision for seizure control.

medicalCondition.name: Anemia
medicalCondition.description: Blood disorder requiring increased iron intake through iron-rich foods and enhanced absorption with vitamin C-rich foods.

medicalCondition.name: Osteoporosis
medicalCondition.description: Bone disorder requiring adequate calcium and vitamin D intake, with limitations on caffeine and alcohol consumption.

medicalCondition.name: Gallbladder Disease
medicalCondition.description: Condition requiring reduced fat intake, particularly saturated and trans fats, and avoidance of cholesterol-rich and fried foods.

medicalCondition.name: Thyroid Disorders
medicalCondition.description: Conditions like hypothyroidism and hyperthyroidism requiring management of iodine intake and balancing cruciferous vegetables for those with hypothyroidism.

medicalCondition.name: GERD
medicalCondition.description: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease requiring avoidance of acidic and spicy foods, reduction of caffeine and chocolate intake, and consuming smaller, more frequent meals.

medicalCondition.name: Gastroparesis
medicalCondition.description: Condition characterized by delayed stomach emptying, requiring consumption of smaller, low-fiber meals and avoidance of high-fat and high-fiber foods.

medicalCondition.name: Multiple Sclerosis
medicalCondition.description: Neurological disorder requiring management of vitamin D intake and emphasis on an anti-inflammatory diet rich in fruits, vegetables, and omega-3 fatty acids.

medicalCondition.name: Hemochromatosis
medicalCondition.description: Genetic disorder causing excess iron absorption, requiring reduction of iron intake and avoiding iron-fortified foods.

medicalCondition.name: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)
medicalCondition.description: Neurodevelopmental disorder requiring consideration of sensory sensitivities and food aversions, with potential exploration of gluten-free and casein-free (GF/CF) diets.

medicalCondition.name: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
medicalCondition.description: Respiratory condition requiring nutrient-dense foods to support respiratory function and adequate protein intake for muscle strength.

medicalCondition.name: Migraines
medicalCondition.description: Neurological condition requiring identification and avoidance of potential trigger foods, along with ensuring regular meals and staying hydrated.

medicalCondition.name: Eosinophilic Esophagitis
medicalCondition.description: Inflammatory condition of the esophagus requiring an elimination diet to identify and avoid trigger foods, and potentially following an elemental diet under medical supervision.
